subject: Ciências
description_pt: Identificar as principais variáveis envolvidas na previsão do tempo e simular situações nas quais elas possam ser medidas.

components.description_pt: Identificar variáveis mensuráveis—temperatura, velocidade do vento, precipitação, insolação—que descrevem condições de tempo
components.description_en: Identify measurable variables—temperature, wind speed, precipitation, and sunlight—that describe weather conditions
components.cc_component_description: Identify measurable variables—temperature, wind speed, precipitation, and sunlight—that describe weather conditions

components.description_pt: Simular medição de variáveis meteorológicas principais usadas em previsão do tempo
components.description_en: Simulate the measurement of key meteorological variables used in weather forecasting
components.cc_component_description: Use weather measurement tools to record and describe current atmospheric conditions

cc_matches.description: Weather is the combination of sunlight, wind, snow or rain, and temperature in a particular region at a particular time. People measure these conditions to describe and record the weather and to notice patterns over time.
